question: Which AI lab's model will rank #1 on the LMArena Text Arena overall leaderboard on October 1, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Incumbent persistence: in the 24 months to Sept 2026 the #1 lab changed in only ~4 of ~73 rolling 10-day windows (~5.5%); Anthropic has held #1 continuously since Feb 2026. Structure amplifies this — the Sept 13 board (latest published, 8 days stale) has Anthropic at #1/#2/#3 (1506/1505/1502), so ordinary vote-noise reshuffles keep an Anthropic model topmost; a challenger must clear ~1506, and the nearest non-Anthropic is Meta at 1500 with a settled six-week-old score. Every named challenger is accounted for: gpt-6-astra-max was added Sept 11 and sits ~20th (Polymarket's debut-at-#1 market resolved NO); Gemini 4 Pro is unannounced with only a battle-mode checkpoint ('argon') sighted Sept 17 and no leaderboard listing; Grok 4.7 missed its Sept 11 and Sept 18 windows and xAI's ceiling on this board is ~1483. Release-to-listing lag was 8 days for Astra, so a challenger would have to ship by ~Sept 23 AND outscore 1506 within 10 days. A deep, near-identical Polymarket contract ($3.5-4M volume, $1M liquidity, resolving 8h before ours off the same board) prices Anthropic 98-99%; I sit slightly below it to hold back tail mass for an unannounced Gemini/Anthropic-rival debut during the reported late-September release cluster and for board-methodology surprises.

(5) Meta's threat level - here Run 3 is closer than Runs 1/2, and I price 'any other lab' above their 0.9-1.2%, since 6 Elo with a +/-11 interval on the resolving view is the single nearest challenger, while discounting it for a six-week-flat settled score and the three-row wall it must clear. I also gave more weight than any run to the fallback clause: the board is already 8 days stale, and a non-refresh mechanically resolves Anthropic. Net: 0.955, below Runs 1/2's implied market pull and well above Run 3's 0.86.
